capabilities: Browse the vault as columns of cards on a rotating cylinder
Pick up files into a stack and carry them between folders
Arrange, play and read carried files on a playground board
Crop and adjust pictures and edit audio and video on the board
Rename, duplicate, cut, copy, paste and trash files with links kept
extras: Needs Obsidian 1.8.7+ with WebGL and hardware acceleration enabled. The editors load whole files into memory (up to 400 MB) and can strain phones; real mobile devices are untested. Overwriting a file always adds a copy to .trash, and releases ship with a GitHub attestation. No telemetry or remote service.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer is a flat list, which gives no spatial or visual way to browse folders, carry files around, or spread them out on a board.
